board.summary: Bad Left Hook supplied the fight slate and source intelligence. God Mode challenged the candidates externally, then the Betting Edge market pass tightened the acceptable prices. No A-grade play is live at the observed prices; Cameron remains the strongest thesis, with Hrgovic, Martinez and Berinchyk held to price-dependent watch levels.

cards.movement: PRICE IMPROVING · MARKET HAS DRIFTED AGAINST CAMERON
cards.rationale: God Mode rates the matchup closer than the favorite-heavy market suggests. The market pass does not show enough margin at roughly +220, so the thesis survives but the entry price moves to +240 or better.

cards.market: MAYER vs CAMERON · METHOD OF VICTORY
cards.movement: CURRENT METHOD PRICE IS TOO SHORT AFTER MARKET-HOLD ADJUSTMENT
cards.rationale: The fight-to-go-the-distance profile supports the method, but +370 does not compensate enough for the method-market hold. Keep the angle, reject the current number, and require roughly +450 or better.

cards.movement: MARKET MOVING AGAINST HRGOVIC · PRICE HAS IMPROVED FOR THE UNDERDOG
cards.rationale: Experience, size and an explicit tactical case keep the upset thesis alive, but the more mature market strongly favors Itauma. Hrgovic becomes interesting only when the price clears the market-derived threshold.

cards.market: MARTINEZ vs PLANTIC · METHOD OF VICTORY
cards.movement: MONEYLINE IS TOO EXPENSIVE · METHOD MARKET NEEDED
cards.rationale: God Mode supports Martinez as the superior side but rejects the heavy moneyline. The only potentially useful route is the stoppage market, which stays off the board until a defensible price is available.

cards.movement: MARKET HAS MOVED TOWARD NOAKES · UNDERDOG PRICE IS APPROACHING INTEREST
cards.rationale: The source work treats Berinchyk as a legitimate opponent rather than a token former champion. The current number is still short of the required upset price, but +500 or better would justify a second analytical pass.
The favorite may be the likelier winner, but the market price is too expensive and offers no useful edge after the market pass.
